items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS safety. Compliance is technical-only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates and block security-sensitive releases; permit only bounded reversible work that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Do not access credentials or private containers, alter permissions or configuration, exploit targets, deploy, add dependencies, or conduct external outreach.

Retain the existing fleet security evidence work item only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. No new proposal, duplicate work item, deployment, credential access, permission change, dependency addition, or outreach is recommended.
